title: NASA’S SPACEX CREW-12 SPLASHES DOWN OFF THE COAST OF CALIFORNIA - Part 1
description: NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway as well as ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Sophie Adenot and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev splashed down off the coast of California Oct. 8 following their undocking from the zenith port of the International Space Station’s Harmony module the previous day. Crew-12 was completing a long-duration mission living and working aboard the microgravity laboratory to advance scientific knowledge and demonstrate new technologies for future human and robotic exploration flights as part of NASA’s Moon and Mars exploration approach, including lunar missions through NASA’s Artemis program.
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
note: Added by the editor by hand: the 115-minute broadcast is over the harvester duration limit; sheet covers reentry to splashdown only (source seconds 3940 to 4560).
